items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: Well, it ain't hauling nobody here, Sugar Boy, Eddie Bowe, I know practically any musician

ctx.x: I met a bunch of studs from up there. I just can't call their names cause they wasn't popular, you know what I mean, but they could play but they never was on nothing. You know, there's fill-in men, call them out to sit in on sessions and things like that. Well, it ain't hauling nobody here, Sugar Boy, Eddie Bowe, I know practically any musician
here. Yeah, I used to see when I was, when I was 15, 14, 15, I used to see Sugar Boy and the Cane Cutters all the time, and Eddie Bowe, Oliver Morgan, and who else?
